The photo shows a stainless steel bowl about 15 cm across at the rim, with roughly 15 dark olives, probably Kalamata, at the bottom. Each olive is about 3-4 g, so 15 olives come to roughly 55 g. Olives run about 115-145 kcal per 100 g, so this serving is about 70-80 kcal. Some oil or brine may be present, so I'll round the estimate up slightly.
